author: sonnet
label: c2-seed-sonnet-01
changes: Added a 2-3 sentence summary covering how the cron email works today and how the new main flow goes.
Added a terms section defining evaluator, breach, alert rule, metrics store, incident manager, Postgres tables, timer queue, schedule service and the provider.
Replaced the bare diagram with one that shows detection, the dedup branch, escalation with stale-timer drop, ack and resolve, and expanded the participant names.
Merged the repeated note bullets (dedup, escalation, push/SMS, resolve) into numbered steps, each with trigger, action, data location and failure handling.
Added the mechanism for coordinating two evaluators: a unique evaluation row per (service, rule, minute) so only one instance acts.
Added the dedup mechanism: a unique index on unresolved incidents per (service, rule).
Added how the 5-minute timers work: queued before sending, with Postgres checked on firing so stale or duplicate timers are ignored.
Added page_log purpose: prevents double pages and lists who gets the resolved notice.
Added a failure table, including both channels failing, schedule lookup failure and metrics store outage.

Kept all first-version facts: 60 s evaluation, 5-min window, 2% and 500 request minimum, 3 breaches, 1% for 10 min, 5-minute escalation order, push with SMS fallback, resolved notice, two evaluators via Postgres, page_log.
Added open questions on 09:00 handover, lost timer messages and webhook authentication; cut nothing else.
